detailed_descriptions.en: Volstead City is rotten and dangerous. Your brother—once the top bootlegger in town—was arrested in a police raid. Now it’s your turn to take over. As Potbellied Racoon and his men try to seize control of the city, you’ll need to dodge both the cops and the criminals while uncovering the truth behind your brother’s arrest. Create your brand, grow your crops, craft your booze, and meet eccentric customers across the city. Complete their quirky missions, build relationships, and grow your underground empire. From beer to hard liquors — grow your ingredients and master the machines to craft a wide variety of drinks. Ferment, distill, barrel-age, and infuse flavors to create truly unique bottles then automate it all for maximum profit. Design your own label, slap it on the bottle, and let the streets of Volstead know your name. Explore three seasonal regions, drive unique vehicles, uncover neighborhoods, and meet a cast of colorful NPCs. Each region has its own unique demands and preferences. Deliver the right drinks to the right neighborhoods, strengthen your contacts, and expand your network. Move through the districts, grow your influence, and become the one who runs the entire town. Volstead’s streets are more than just business. Gangs make their own rules, and mistakes are never forgiven. Stay sharp, know who you’re dealing with, and stay alert if you want to survive.
